LanguageData.RimSense_Danger: Danger: hostiles on a colonist map (red)
LanguageData.RimSense_DangerDesc: Lights your SteelSeries devices red while hostiles threaten a map where your colonists are.
LanguageData.RimSense_FlashDesc: Flashes when a new alert begins (red: 10 fast, amber: 3 slow), then stays steady while it lasts. Turn off for steady colors only.
LanguageData.RimSense_Attention: Attention: a colonist in trouble or a large fire (amber)
LanguageData.RimSense_AttentionDesc: Amber while a colonist is about to have or is having a major or extreme mental break, is bleeding out, or is giving birth, or while a large fire is burning.
LanguageData.RimSense_StatusNotFound: not found. Is SteelSeries GG running?
LanguageData.RimSense_StatusUnsupported: not available on this operating system
LanguageData.RimSense_ColorsHint: Colors and devices can be changed in GG: Engine → Apps → RimWorld → Configure.
